pages.prompt: Create a new 512x512 square illustration-story page for an English educational picture book MY NEW FRIEND. Attached picture is a STYLE reference only: polished warm volumetric cartoon, expressive friendly faces, natural soft window light, gentle shadows and lightly textured neutral room. Two late-teen students: Li, short dark hair, plain blue overshirt and beige trousers; Anna, long dark-brown hair, cream knit top and dark jeans. Page 1: Li is at the open entrance to a cozy learning room, greeting Anna with a natural small hand gesture. Anna is near a wooden study table with two chairs and smiles back warmly. Both faces visible. Show one complete daily-life scene with clear volume, natural perspective, generous padding, minimal clutter. This scene will introduce Li as narrator; DO NOT print his name or any text. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, speech bubbles, arrows, watermark, collage, panels, diagrams, flat icons or stick figures. Keep school materials closed or blank without readable writing.
